name: comp-465

frames.best_why: Shows the full pager and the Go to page field side by side with the cursor away.

tagline: A small numbered pager beside a box for typing a page to jump to.
summary: A slim pager with Previous and Next around pages 1 to 4 and an ellipsis, paired with a Go to page field for typing a number directly.
appearance: On black, a tiny arrow-led pager shows pages 1 to 4 with 3 in a rounded box and an ellipsis before the forward arrow. Across a wide gap at the right, a Go to page label sits beside a narrow outlined text box.
behaviour: The page links follow hash links while the text box accepts typed digits, here changing from 3 to 7. Nothing animates and the active page stays on 3.
demo_content: Pages 1 to 4 with page 3 active, and a Go to page field holding 3 or 7.
search_phrases: pagination with a jump to page box
type a page number to go there
page links and a small input
numbered pager with go to field
pager with ellipsis and page box
use_when: Long result sets where a numbered pager and a direct page box share one row.
avoid_when: When the box must navigate: there is no button or Enter handler, so typing alone does nothing.
customise: currentPage and totalPages set the page links and the input's starting value; the input width and the row gap are classes.
weight_why: A short pager and one text input; nothing loops or animates.

a11y.note: The input is tied to its label and each arrow is named; the page field does not act on Enter, so its value is not submitted.

issues: The Go to page input has no submit handler, so typing a page does nothing on its own.
polish_why: Tidy but very small controls with a wide empty gap between the pager and the page field.
title: Pagination With Counter
